story: Five early attackers, including Healy, Skjelmose, and Soler, formed the breakaway, while a strong Uno-X-led chase group controlled the gap at around one minute. Meanwhile the gap to the gc favourites increased to over 4 minutes. Paul Seixas launched a long solo move with 57 km to go, briefly gaining ground before being caught back by the favourites. The chase group eventually reeled in the breakaway before the final climb, where Andrew August attacked decisively to win solo. Tobias Halland Johannessen completed his team’s strong effort by securing a final podium place. Paul Seixas finished four minutes behind and sealed his first WorldTour stage race overall victory.
